title: Entropy equality and local symmetry in negative curvature
main_claim: Take a closed Riemannian manifold of dimension n>=3 with strictly negative sectional curvature. Normalized Liouville measure has maximal entropy for the geodesic flow (h_{m_L}=h_top) if and only if the metric is locally symmetric (nabla R = 0). This would settle Katok's entropy rigidity conjecture in these dimensions.

issues.description: This is not a defect in the paper. It records how deep the audit went. The analytic machinery is long and relies on many interlocking quantifier and exponent choices: nonstationary normal forms, the Zariski-closure hulls, approximation of transported plaques, actualization by finite truncation, and propagation of the leaf label. I checked the order in which constants are chosen and the main exponent inequalities, for example W>4(K+log L_k+2), kappa(b+1)>K, and choosing R before the interpolation order q. I found no failing step. I did not verify every lemma line by line, so a subtle error in these parts is not excluded. Readers should treat the verdict on these parts as a structural check, not a full certification.
issues.evidence: e.g. Lemma hull:actual-approximation: 'Finally choose W>4(K+log L_k+2), then S by (hull:spatial-choice), then the requisite finite level'; Prop real:actualization; Prop smooth:propagation

coverage:
I read every section and the completion of the proof in main.tex. I checked these steps in detail:
(1) Prop pre:entropy-forms. The transport identity phi_t^*u = e^{-ht}u follows from d/dt(q'-Uq) = -U(q'-Uq) and J = h+XF. The periodic-orbit Gibbs comparison and the Livsic step are fine.
(2) Raw dynamics, Lemma nf:raw-dynamics. Symplecticity gives D_yB = D_xA^{-t}, and the quotient exponents are sums of j+1 (graph) or j (density) stable exponents.
(3) Lemma sym:trace. L_{Z_p}u at the center is (tr A_p|E^s - h xi(p))u, and the cross-pairing kills it. In Prop sym:effective the action on E is -A_p, which gives c = -h. Both signs are consistent.
(4) Prop sym:dilation. The augmented weight of (u(0),1) is zero, because the stable Lyapunov sum is -hT only under entropy equality. So D - T d_tau preserves the hulls.
(5) Section 5:
- the abelian-ideal exclusion and the minimal-ideal argument;
- the Cartan-Guillemin input and its normalizers (CH_n, CS_n);
- the equicontinuity and origin-stabilizer characterization of l, and coisotropy of L;
- the radical/[g,r] reduction, reductivity of u', and the trace-positivity argument that forces pure-sign isotypic constituents (upper-segment sums are positive);
- in the infinite case, flip invariance gives rank P^s = rank P^u > 0.
(6) Section 6. Completeness and properness of the affine ray via returns with gaps o(n). Decay estimate G_{n,k} = O(e^{-c0 k n}) via sampling plus interpolation. The stable-tangency remainder bookkeeping. The Busemann contradiction: b_{zeta_t}(a(t)) -> -infinity, while z(t) stays in a compact set and shares past endpoint and horosphere with a(t).
(7) Section 7. Weight argument for B=0 (tangency). The crossing identity and induction for subexponential bounds. The R-independent rate B_j in the approximants. Nondegeneracy of dq from the bounded holonomy Jacobian.
(8) Proof of Prop pre:smooth-rigidity. The BFL closed-form correction is exact by the inverse-class argument. Scaling: Vol(g0) = a^n Vol(g) and h_top(g) = a h_top(g0), so a^2 g matches volume and entropy for BCG/Ruan. The converse via constant J = tr sqrt(-R_v) is fine.
I did not verify line by line: the measurable-selection details in sections 3 and 5, and every interpolation constant in sections 2, 3, 6 and 7.
sibling_notes: The hive board for family 339 (hive:oai_math:review:fam:339) was empty when I started, so no sibling or companion results were available. The paper cites external literature only (BFL, BCG, Ruan, Fattori-Kac, Bakalov-D'Andrea-Kac, Climenhaga, Humbert2026) and no companion OAI preprints, so there is no circular dependence to check. I posted my verdict to the board.
